clarification.t_minus_7_completed_closes: exact UTC cutoff date t minus 7 calendar days because the canonical crypto source clock is one completed UTC close per calendar day
clarification.t_minus_14_completed_closes: exact UTC cutoff date t minus 14 calendar days
clarification.missing_exact_required_snapshot: FAIL_CLOSED_NO_SIGNAL; never substitute the nearest available snapshot
clarification.future_snapshots: must never be read or used; their presence outside the exact three required paths cannot change output
